institute-of-science-and-technology.description: Institute of Science and Technology is a self-financed engineering college at Chandrakona in Paschim Medinipur, set up to bring technical education to rural West Bengal.
institute-of-science-and-technology.about: The institute started in 2005 and is sponsored by the Gopsai Avinandan Sangha society. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology for B.Tech, M.Tech and other degree courses, and to the state council for diploma courses. It offers civil, mechanical, electrical, electrical and electronics, computer science, and electronics and communication engineering.
institute-of-science-and-technology.address: Dhurabila, Dhamkuria, Chandrakona Town, Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal 721201
institute-of-science-and-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

college-of-engineering-and-management-ko.description: College of Engineering and Management, Kolaghat is an engineering college inside the Kolaghat Thermal Power Plant township in Purba Medinipur.
college-of-engineering-and-management-ko.about: CEMK was established in September 1998 and is run by the Vidyasagar Society for Integrated Learning. Its 32 acre campus lies within the Kolaghat Thermal Power Plant township managed by WBPDCL. Its programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to MAKAUT, and its computer science department is NBA accredited.
college-of-engineering-and-management-ko.address: PO KTPP Township, Purba Medinipur, West Bengal 721171
college-of-engineering-and-management-ko.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

haldia-institute-of-technology.description: Haldia Institute of Technology is an autonomous engineering college in the ICARE complex at Haldia, and the oldest self-financed degree engineering college in West Bengal.
haldia-institute-of-technology.about: HIT started in 1996 as an institution of ICARE, Haldia. It is the oldest self-financed degree engineering college in the state. It holds autonomous status under Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal.
haldia-institute-of-technology.address: ICARE Complex, HIT Campus, PO HIT, Haldia, Purba Medinipur, West Bengal 721657
haldia-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

ramkrishna-mahato-government-engineering.description: Ramkrishna Mahato Government Engineering College is a fully government-funded engineering college at Agharpur near Ramamoti in Purulia district.
ramkrishna-mahato-government-engineering.about: The college, formerly Purulia Government Engineering College, was inaugurated in 2016. It is fully funded by the Government of West Bengal and approved by AICTE. It is located at Agharpur in the Joypur police station area of Purulia.
ramkrishna-mahato-government-engineering.address: Vill Agharpur, PO Ramamoti, PS Joypur, Dist Purulia, West Bengal 723103

budge-budge-institute-of-technology.description: Budge Budge Institute of Technology is a private engineering college at Nischintapur, Budge Budge, in South 24 Parganas, accredited by NAAC with a B++ grade.
budge-budge-institute-of-technology.about: BBIT was established in 2009. It is accredited by NAAC with a B++ grade. Its four B.Tech programmes in electronics and communication, computer science, electrical and mechanical engineering are NBA accredited.
budge-budge-institute-of-technology.address: Nischintapur, Budge Budge, Kolkata, West Bengal 700137

calcutta-institute-of-engineering-and-ma.description: Calcutta Institute of Engineering and Management is a self-financed private engineering college on Chandi Ghosh Road in Tollygunge, Kolkata.
calcutta-institute-of-engineering-and-ma.about: CIEM is a self-financed private engineering college approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses in engineering, technology and allied fields. It holds a NAAC B+ grade.
calcutta-institute-of-engineering-and-ma.address: 24/1A Chandi Ghosh Road, Tollygunge, Kolkata, West Bengal 700040
calcutta-institute-of-engineering-and-ma.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

dream-institute-of-technology.description: Dream Institute of Technology is a private engineering college at Samali, Thakurpukur, on Bakhrahat Road in south-west Kolkata.
dream-institute-of-technology.about: DIT was established in 2006, when its computer science and electronics and communication departments began. A civil engineering department followed in 2014. All programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology.
dream-institute-of-technology.address: Thakurpukur, Samali, B. H. Road, Kolkata, West Bengal 700104
dream-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

future-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.description: Future Institute of Engineering and Management is a private engineering and management college on Sonarpur Station Road, part of the Future Education group.
future-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.about: FIEM is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly WBUT). Its campus is at Teghoria on Sonarpur Station Road. It offers B.Tech and M.Tech programmes in several engineering fields along with management and computer application courses.
future-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.address: Sonarpur Station Road, Teghoria, Kolkata, West Bengal 700150
future-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

gargi-memorial-institute-of-technology-c.description: Gargi Memorial Institute of Technology is a private engineering college at Balarampur near Baruipur in South 24 Parganas, run jointly with the JIS Group since 2019.
gargi-memorial-institute-of-technology-c.about: GMIT was established in 2011 at Baruipur. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. In 2019 it entered a joint venture with the JIS Group, and it offers four-year B.Tech courses in six disciplines.
gargi-memorial-institute-of-technology-c.address: Balarampur, Mouza Beralia, Baruipur, Kolkata, West Bengal 700144
gargi-memorial-institute-of-technology-c.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

greater-kolkata-college-of-engineering-a.description: Greater Kolkata College of Engineering and Management is a JIS Group engineering college near Phultala, Baruipur, in South 24 Parganas.
greater-kolkata-college-of-engineering-a.about: GKCEM is one of the JIS Group's educational initiatives and started in 2008. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. Its campus is near Phultala in Baruipur.
greater-kolkata-college-of-engineering-a.address: Baruipur, near Phultala, South 24 Parganas, West Bengal 743387
greater-kolkata-college-of-engineering-a.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal
